title: Pointer to the properties of [def-wf-tate-twist]
text:
In the notation of [def-wf-tate-twist], the following holds. The functorial pullback of
roots of unity giving a strict arrow
$\Phi_X^*E(1)\stackrel{\sim}{\to}E(1)$, and the commutation with
finite scalar extension, are [lem-wf-tate-twist-compatibility].
